SELECT 
  MIN(business_date) AS min_date,
  MAX(business_date) AS max_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) AS days_count
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales

SELECT 
  YEAR(business_date) AS year,
  MONTH(business_date) AS month,
  SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) AS trading_days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY YEAR(business_date), MONTH(business_date)

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS store_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) AS trading_days,
  SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_calendar_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trading_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_public_holiday THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS public_holidays
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-09-01' AND calendar_date < '2026-10-01'

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores,
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) AS days,
  COUNT(*) / (COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) * COUNT(DISTINCT business_date)) AS rows_per_store_day
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'

SELECT TOP 5
  business_date,
  store_id,
  receipts,
  units_sold,
  net_sales_before_returns,
  returns_net,
  net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'
ORDER BY business_date, store_id
